name: Deflationary model

subjectOf.text: Seventy-two of the top 100 tokens cap the number of tokens that will ever be issued, a deflationary model of token issuance.
subjectOf.abstract: Seventy-two tokens in the dataset capped the number of tokens that will ever be issued by the respective token issuer, otherwise known as a deflationary model of token issuance.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Crypto Economics - The Top 100 Token Models Compared (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3249860

subjectOf.text: Under a deflationary token model, prices are expected to increase because of the fundamental scarcity of token supply.
subjectOf.abstract: With a deflationary method, prices are expected to increase due to fundamental scarcity of token supply.
